# Empowering healthier lives
# through nutrition

[LEARN MORE ABOUT US][49]

## Nestlé Health Science empowers patients and consumers to thrive throughout their health and
## nutrition journeys by offering an extensive and diverse product portfolio. We provide nutrition
## and nourishment where it's needed most from cancer patients dealing with malnutrition to marathon
## runners.

## Our
## Brands

### **Our Expertise**

As a leader in the science of nutrition, our expertise in active lifestyle nutrition, medical
nutrition, and pharmaceutical therapies is rooted in science and covers every facet of health
including prevention, maintenance and treatment.

[Active Lifestyle Nutrition][50]

Active lifestyle nutrition is all about helping today’s consumers find the right solutions to help
them lead healthier lives – from those who wish to fill a nutritional gap to high-performance
athletes at the top of their game.

[Our Active Lifestyle Nutrition Brands][51]

[Medical Nutrition][52]

Our medical nutrition portfolio provides essential nutrition for an array of health conditions
ranging from cerebral palsy patients to those living with diabetes.

[Our Medical Nutrition Brands][53]

[Pharmaceutical Therapies][54]

Our approach to healthier lives includes pharmaceutical therapies focused on food, GI, and
metabolic-related diseases.

[Our Pharmaceutical Therapies][55]

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

## Healthcare Professionals

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

[Healthcare Professionals][9]
* [ Primary Care ][10]
  
  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening
* [ Hospital Care ][11]
  
  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows
* [ Surgical Care ][12]
  
  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility
* [ Our Products & Services ][15]
  
  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

## Perspectives

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

[Perspectives][16]
* [ Patients' Stories ][17]
  
  Patients’ journeys inspire our work and drive our commitment.
* [ Healthcare Insights ][18]
  
  We’re engaging with industry thought leaders to explore how science and innovation advance
  healthcare.
* [ People of Baxter ][19]
  
  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.
* [ Community Engagement ][20]
  
  Enriching the communities where we live and work.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]
* [ General Healthcare ][29]
  
  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This

corporate social responsibility program.

  Take a look at our list of businesses.
  
  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# ADVANCING CARE TO OPTIMIZE OUTCOMES in medically supervised settings

At Talphera, we are focused on the development and commercialization of innovative therapies for use
in medically supervised settings. Grounded in the understanding that patient outcomes depend on the
quality of the tools available to a patient’s medical team, our product candidates are designed to
ensure the best care to patients while offering improved cost and convenience for healthcare
providers.

When we founded our company, formerly known as AcelRx Pharmaceuticals, our mission was to deliver
innovative acute pain products to healthcare providers in the medically supervised setting. With the
divestment of our acute pain product in 2023, we embarked on a broader mission to develop and
commercialize innovative products for medically supervised settings. In recognition of this new era,
we renamed our company Talphera. The name was derived from “Talisman”, meaning a strong leader, and
reflects the new “pharmaceutical era” for the company. Our mission at Talphera is to support
healthcare providers by developing and commercializing products in medically supervised settings
that deliver advances in care to patients.

Our lead candidate, Niyad® (nafamostat mesylate), is positioned to be the first FDA-approved
regional anticoagulant for use in the extracorporeal circuit with the potential to meaningfully
improve the standard of care for patients undergoing renal replacement therapy (RRT).

## OUR PORTFOLIO

### Nafamostat: A pipeline-in-a-product

Nafamostat is a broad-spectrum serine protease inhibitor with anticoagulant, anti-inflammatory, and
potential antiviral properties with a variety of applications in medically supervised settings.¹ Our
lead product candidate, Niyad®, a lyophilized form of nafamostat, leverages the ultrashort half-life
of nafamostat and its potent anticoagulant effects for potential use as an anticoagulant in dialysis
in patients who cannot tolerate heparin or who have an increased risk of bleeding.

In addition to the decades of use in Japan and South Korea as an anticoagulant for dialysis
circuits, acute pancreatitis, and disseminated intravascular coagulation, nafamostat has been widely
studied for many applications, including as an anticoagulant for the extracorporeal circuit. A
meta-analysis published in 2022 compared the safety and efficacy of the use of nafamostat in the
extracorporeal circuit against conventional therapies and demonstrated that nafamostat provided
significant safety and efficacy improvements over those current standards of care.²

### Targeting a new standard of care for
### use in renal replacement therapy (“RRT”).

Heparin, a systemic anticoagulant with a variable half-life of 1 to 3 hours, has long been the
standard anticoagulant for use in dialysis. However, heparin is not safe for patients with a high
risk of bleeding or heparin intolerance, leaving limited alternatives for this large patient
population.³

# We are now Cencora. Our shared identity unites us.

Cencora brings the companies and services of AmerisourceBergen together under one new name.

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]
[GettyImages-907614352_JPG]

Committed to helping you enhance your practice and the experience of your patients through connected
devices and digitalised data sharing.

  Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
  vitals monitoring and vision screening

  Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
  workflows

  Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
  outcomes
* [ Nutritional Care ][13]
  
  Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and
  at home
* [ Respiratory Health ][14]
  
  Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve
  mobility

  Our portfolio of acute, nutritional, hospital and surgical care products helps advance healthcare
  around the world.

For nearly a century, we have worked at the intersection of saving and sustaining lives.

  We are a community of diverse professionals working together to drive better healthcare options.

## Our Story

Our 90-year heritage gives us distinct perspective on the needs of patients and caregivers. We lead
today by putting those insights to work to deliver new, better healthcare solutions and access to
care in the communities where we live and work.

[Our Story][21]
* [ Our Leadership ][22]
  
  Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet the needs of all our
  stakeholders – every day and everywhere.
* [ Our Governance ][23]
  
  We are proud of our strong commitment to maintaining the highest standards of corporate
  governance.
* [ Fueling Collaborative Innovation ][24]
  
  Nurturing a culture of innovation is critical to delivering on our mission to save and sustain
  lives. We partner with the healthcare community to continually find more efficient, smarter ways
  to help solve the world's most pressing healthcare challenges.
* [ Baxter Sustainability ][25]
  
  We strive to create lasting value by delivering sustainable healthcare, advancing climate and
  resiliency, and championing our people and communities.
* [ Inclusion & Diversity ][26]
  
  We are committed to attracting, motivating and retaining an inclusive and diverse workforce.
* [ Our History ][27]
  
  For nearly a century, we’ve been focused on saving and sustaining lives and elevating patient
  care.

## Patients

Helping you reach a healthy life, full of possibility.

[Patients][28]

  Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
  support every step of your journey.
* [ Nutritional Care ][30]
  
  When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide life-saving
  clinical nutrition options to help you regain your nutritional status.
* [ Respiratory Health ][31]
  
  We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven
  respiratory therapy in the hospital and at home.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

## Evofem Biosciences is revolutionizing women’s sexual and reproductive healthcare with a
## first-in-class innovative hormone-free contraceptive.

Evofem’s mission is to empower women by providing products that give women the control and
flexibility they desire.

Launched in 2020, FDA-approved PHEXX^{® }(lactic acid, citric acid and potassium bitartrate) vaginal
gel is a first-in-class hormone-free, on-demand prescription contraception that a woman can control.

Fulfilling a critical unmet need in the contraceptive space, PHEXX provides an FDA-approved
localized option designed for women to use at their discretion 0-60 minutes prior to each act of
intercourse.

PHEXX is a hormone-free birth control women have been waiting for.

[Meet Our PHEXX Ambassador][42]

### A Hormone-Free Revolution in Birth Control

#### Empowering women to break the status quo on hormonal birth control.

## Significant
## Market Opportunity

Evofem is Leading a New Era in Women’s Contraception Targeting a Multi-Billion Dollar Market
Opportunity
* PHEXX net sales increased in the third quarter of 2022 for the fourth consecutive quarter.
* Net product sales had already surpassed 2021 levels in the first half of 2022.  
* Payers and pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) continue to add PHEXX to their formularies, allowing
  women to fill their prescriptions immediately.
* Updated guidelines from the U.S. Department of Labor and Health Resources and Services
  Administration (HRSA) took effect on January 1, 2023, for calendar year plans. These guidelines
  clarify that most group health plans and insurers must cover FDA-approved contraceptives,
  including PHEXX, at no cost to individuals under the Affordable Care Act (ACA)
* Partnership discussions are ongoing for the commercialization of PHEXX in international markets.

[click here][43]

## A Paradigm Shift in Contraception

23M+ women in the U.S. are not using a hormonal contraceptive.²

As the organic movement grows, society is trending in favor of more natural products and solutions.
Women’s healthcare is no different. Many women are now opting for a non-hormonal, localized method
of birth control. 

Because PHEXX is a non-hormonal birth control, it is not associated with side effects like
depression, mood swings and irritability. With PHEXX, women do not need to choose between their
quality of life or contraception.

Taking hormones may not be right for some women especially for those with certain medical conditions
including clotting disorders and most cancers, limiting their birth control options. There are
approximately 800,000 new cases of cancer reported annually among women.³  PHEXX uniquely offers
hormone-free, non-invasive prescription contraception.

the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. Skip to content

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Patients are Our Passion


The right drugs, the right knowledge and the right people can transform everyday decisions into
everyday triumphs.

[Learn More][13]
**Our Products**
**NUZYRA®**  is an FDA-approved tetracycline-class antibiotic designed to address a significant
unmet need for adult patients with CABP and ABSSSI caused by susceptible bacteria.
[About NUZYRA®][14]

**XHANCE®** is a prescription nasal spray approved by the U.S. FDA for the treatment of chronic
rhinosinusitis with or without nasal polyps in adults.
[About XHANCE®][15]
**Groundbreaking Innovators**
A disciplined team with proven capabilities in developing and commercializing new treatment options
for complex medical issues.
‍

[Meet Our Team][16]
**Powered by You**
Our employees are experienced, committed, and driven to build a company that makes a positive
difference in patients' lives. Learn more about how you can join our team.
[View Open Roles][17]

## Taking on the Challenge of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)

"Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a critical, global public health issue and an ongoing pandemic.
Efforts to combat AMR require a multi-pronged approach, including responsible antibiotic use,
improved surveillance, research into new antibiotics, and policy changes to enable a vibrant
marketplace that recognizes the life-saving value of novel antibiotics. Paratek is a
biopharmaceutical company that is dedicated to addressing AMR, a critical concern for public health
and national security."

#### Evan Loh, M.D. CEO, Paratek

[Taking on the Challenge of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)][18]

## Expanding Impact in Chronic Rhinosinusitis

Treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis (CRS) requires additional innovations, including in methods of
delivery to the site of inflammation. Paratek is committed to reaching both specialists and primary
care providers to address the unmet patient needs in CRS.


[Expanding Impact in Chronic Rhinosinusitis][19]

## Building a Stronger Future in Specialty Pharmaceuticals

Paratek provides innovative therapies for specialists and community care providers. Our portfolio of
products help address public health threats and important unmet medical needs.


[Building a Stronger Future in Specialty Pharmaceuticals][20]

##### Healthcare Professionals

## Expanding Impact in Chronic Rhinosinusitis

Treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis (CRS) requires additional innovations, including in methods of
delivery to the site of inflammation. Paratek is committed to reaching both specialists and primary
care providers to address the unmet patient needs in CRS.

[Learn More About CRS][21]

##### Healthcare Professionals

## Taking on the Challenge of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)

"Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a critical, global public health issue and an ongoing pandemic.
Efforts to combat AMR require a multi-pronged approach, including responsible antibiotic use,
improved surveillance, research into new antibiotics, and policy changes to enable a vibrant
marketplace that recognizes the life-saving value of novel antibiotics. Paratek is a
biopharmaceutical company that is dedicated to addressing AMR, a critical concern for public health
and national security."

# Developing Novel Medicines for Immune-Mediated Diseases

Spero Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing innovative medicines for
immune-mediated diseases, beginning with SP001, a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody in
development for IgG4-related disease.

### Building Value

### Purposeful Selection, Agile Execution

Spero prioritizes programs where compelling biology, clear patient need, and meaningful
differentiation from existing treatment options converge. Building on a proven track record of
clinical development and execution, including the successful development of Utebzi™¹, our team is
advancing therapies with the potential to meaningfully improve patients’ lives.

[About Us][17]

### SP001 in Rheumatology

### Where Biology, Patient Need, and Clinical Path Converge

SP001 is a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody, designed to inhibit a key immune signaling pathway
involved in driving inflammation and disease. By acting upstream in the immune cascade, SP001 has
the potential to reduce disease activity without broadly eliminating immune cells. Spero is
advancing SP001 in IgG4-related disease, a rare, systemic disease marked by chronic inflammation and
tissue fibrosis, and evaluating its potential in additional immune-mediated conditions.

[Programs][18]

#### ¹*Utebzi *(*Tebipenem pivoxil) was developed in collaboration with GSK. GSK entered into an
#### exclusive license agreement with Spero Therapeutics for the development and commercialization
#### in all markets, except certain Asian territories.*

various common conditions like sleeplessness, intestinal discomfort, and high cholesterol. However,

right supplements, dosage, frequency, and timing for clients.
[medium brown arrow]

Dell Datacenter Capacity Planner

browser-based tool accessible on Dell.com.
[medium brown arrow]

“I’ve used Vertex as both “staff augmentation” and as a stand-alone resource for internet/web
development or ecommerce projects. I’ve often described Vertex as a “blue collar” style agency –
where they are primarily focused on solving the problem at hand – getting into the nuts and bolts of
really fixing the issue…Definitely recommended as a trusted and helpful resource that can grow and
scale with your company’s needs.”

Paul Laster
DELL TECHNOLOGIES

“Vertex has built multiple complex platforms for me over the last 15 years. I am so grateful for
their expertise, guidance, and cutting-edge technology. They are very careful and think of all the
issues that we do not even imagine ourselves. Their planning, engineering expertise and
communication is second to none. I hope to work with them for many years to come.”

Pam Machemehl Helmly
WELLNICITY

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

## Leading Innovation Across critical fields of research

At ARSI Canada Inc., we deliver specialized pharmaceutical research solutions designed to support
every stage of discovery and development. From custom synthesis and scale-up to advanced analytics
and regulatory studies, our services combine scientific expertise with innovation to ensure
precision, reliability, and real-world impact.

##### Custom Synthesis Services

ARSI Canada provides custom synthesis services to meet your specific needs. Our team of experienced
scientists can synthesize complex molecules, APIs, and intermediates from small to large scale.

##### Scale-up services

At ARSI Canada, we offer custom pre-clinical scale-up services, bridging the gap from
milligram-scale synthesis to gram-to-kilo quantities. Contact us for a free consultation and elevate
your research!

##### Catalogue Compounds

Accelerate your research with our 2000+ in-stock catalogue compounds. Discover building blocks,
metabolites, reference standards, and more for drug discovery and chemical research.

##### Analytical Method Development

Ensure reliable and accurate results with our meticulous method development and validation services.
Chromatography, spectroscopy, and regulatory expertise tailored to your project.

##### Structure Elucidation

Unlock the secrets of your molecules with our advanced analytical techniques. NMR,MS, IR, and expert
interpretation elucidate even the most complex structures.

##### Forced Degradation Studies

Assess product stability and identify degradation pathways with our comprehensive forced degradation
studies. Ensure quality and meet regulatory requirements (ICH guidelines).

##### Drug Development Services

Accelerate your drug development pipeline with our tailored services. From synthesis and analytical
support to regulatory insights, we partner with you every step of the way..

##### Consulting Services

Tap into our deep expertise in organic chemistry and drug development. Strategic guidance and
customized solutions to address your unique challenges.

##### Contract Laboratory Services

Extend your capabilities with our flexible contract laboratory services. Access world-class
facilities, state-of-the-art instrumentation, and seasoned scientific expertise on demand.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

# **ESV Pharma**

**PHARMACUETICAL   PRODUCTS**

## Canadian Based Pharmaceutical Products

ESV Pharma is committed towards the healthcare of the citizens to the pharmacists and to the medical
community to meet the challenges of today’s rapidly changing pharmaceutical environment. Offering
best in class medicines, ESV Pharma is distributing its products across various markets through an
efficient supply chain.

### OUR VISION

We are a pharmaceutical company of future. Our Vision is to become a leading and dominant
pharmaceutical company in North America that complies with global market trends and standards and at
the same time sets its own leading standards.

### OUR MISSION

Our Mission is to provide our customers with the products of best quality and price and at the same
time to bring them Happiness, Health and Wellness. Our Business model delivers outstanding value to
all stakeholders.

### OUR GOAL

ESV Pharma is committed towards the healthcare of the citizens to the pharmacists and to the medical
community to meet the challenges of today’s rapidly changing pharmaceutical environment.

# ABOUT US

#### ESV Pharma is a privately owned company that was established in 2005. During these years of
#### serious activity, we have collected a large amount of experience in pharma business.
#### Over 15 years we have been present in the global pharmaceutical market and this has made us an
#### influential enterprise in the pharmaceutical service community, continuously adjusting our
#### development to the increasing demands of our customers’ individual requirements.
#### We have been innovative, diversified, flexible and fast growing. So we have been able to prove
#### ourselves as a reliable partner during these years and to build strong and long-term
#### collaborations with the most successful companies across the world and at the same time to
#### provide unmatched services to our customers and suppliers around the globe.

# Our Staff

We are a team of young, motivated and committed to result professionals, specialized in
international pharmaceutical distribution.
Our experienced staff includes pharmacists and physicians skilled in pharmaceutical production,
storage, distribution, sales and marketing teams ready to assist and fulfill your purchasing needs.
Our flexible and costumer-oriented employees can easily fulfill their tasks in the most complicated
and hard conditions.

## ESV Pharma Has Been Registered As A Leading Canadian Pharmaceutical Company

## ESV Pharma is an import and export company

We are an authorized pharmaceutical importer and exporter, trading among all North American,
European and South Korean companies. We have a great experience in import and export of Health
products from and to North American Subcontinent. Our long term experience in trading worldwide has
made the sourcing of products from all around the world an easy task for us.

suspected osteomyelitis.

prophylactic indication is unlikely to provide benefit to the patient and increases the risk of
development of drug-resistant bacteria.

## Adverse Reactions

The most common adverse reactions (≥3%) in patients treated with ORBACTIV® were headache, nausea,
vomiting, limb and subcutaneous abscesses, and diarrhea.

to overcome hyper-cellular mutation of bacteria and viruses. Recce’s anti-infectives are unique –
their potency does not diminish even with repeated use, a common failure associated with existing
drugs.

to treat’ bacterial infections – including their mutated forms.

encompassing major therapeutic categories such as Cardiovascular, Neurology, Psychiatric, Hepatitis,

  Complete testing capabilities: ICH stability, endotoxins, microbial limits, preservative efficacy,

  Our in-house quality philosophy that ensures every batch meets not just compliance, but
  consistency.

  Built to handle high-volume demand with low MOQs, high agility, and 24/7 audit readiness.

  Including formulation, packaging, licensing, testing, documentation, and dispatch — all under one

# ADVANCING CARE TO OPTIMIZE OUTCOMES in medically supervised settings

At Talphera, we are focused on the development and commercialization of innovative therapies for use
in medically supervised settings. Grounded in the understanding that patient outcomes depend on the
quality of the tools available to a patient’s medical team, our product candidates are designed to
ensure the best care to patients while offering improved cost and convenience for healthcare
providers.

When we founded our company, formerly known as AcelRx Pharmaceuticals, our mission was to deliver
innovative acute pain products to healthcare providers in the medically supervised setting. With the
divestment of our acute pain product in 2023, we embarked on a broader mission to develop and
commercialize innovative products for medically supervised settings. In recognition of this new era,
we renamed our company Talphera. The name was derived from “Talisman”, meaning a strong leader, and
reflects the new “pharmaceutical era” for the company. Our mission at Talphera is to support
healthcare providers by developing and commercializing products in medically supervised settings
that deliver advances in care to patients.

Our lead candidate, Niyad® (nafamostat mesylate), is positioned to be the first FDA-approved
regional anticoagulant for use in the extracorporeal circuit with the potential to meaningfully
improve the standard of care for patients undergoing renal replacement therapy (RRT).

## OUR PORTFOLIO

### Nafamostat: A pipeline-in-a-product

Nafamostat is a broad-spectrum serine protease inhibitor with anticoagulant, anti-inflammatory, and
potential antiviral properties with a variety of applications in medically supervised settings.¹ Our
lead product candidate, Niyad®, a lyophilized form of nafamostat, leverages the ultrashort half-life
of nafamostat and its potent anticoagulant effects for potential use as an anticoagulant in dialysis
in patients who cannot tolerate heparin or who have an increased risk of bleeding.

In addition to the decades of use in Japan and South Korea as an anticoagulant for dialysis
circuits, acute pancreatitis, and disseminated intravascular coagulation, nafamostat has been widely
studied for many applications, including as an anticoagulant for the extracorporeal circuit. A
meta-analysis published in 2022 compared the safety and efficacy of the use of nafamostat in the
extracorporeal circuit against conventional therapies and demonstrated that nafamostat provided
significant safety and efficacy improvements over those current standards of care.²

### use in renal replacement therapy (“RRT”).

standard anticoagulant for use in dialysis. However, heparin is not safe for patients with a high
risk of bleeding or heparin intolerance, leaving limited alternatives for this large patient
population.³

## Evofem Biosciences is revolutionizing women’s sexual and reproductive healthcare with a
## first-in-class innovative hormone-free contraceptive.

Evofem’s mission is to empower women by providing products that give women the control and
flexibility they desire.

Launched in 2020, FDA-approved PHEXX^{® }(lactic acid, citric acid and potassium bitartrate) vaginal
gel is a first-in-class hormone-free, on-demand prescription contraception that a woman can control.

Fulfilling a critical unmet need in the contraceptive space, PHEXX provides an FDA-approved
localized option designed for women to use at their discretion 0-60 minutes prior to each act of
intercourse.

PHEXX is a hormone-free birth control women have been waiting for.

[Meet Our PHEXX Ambassador][42]

### A Hormone-Free Revolution in Birth Control

#### Empowering women to break the status quo on hormonal birth control.

## Significant
## Market Opportunity

Evofem is Leading a New Era in Women’s Contraception Targeting a Multi-Billion Dollar Market
Opportunity
* PHEXX net sales increased in the third quarter of 2022 for the fourth consecutive quarter.
* Net product sales had already surpassed 2021 levels in the first half of 2022.  
* Payers and pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) continue to add PHEXX to their formularies, allowing
  women to fill their prescriptions immediately.
* Updated guidelines from the U.S. Department of Labor and Health Resources and Services
  Administration (HRSA) took effect on January 1, 2023, for calendar year plans. These guidelines
  clarify that most group health plans and insurers must cover FDA-approved contraceptives,
  including PHEXX, at no cost to individuals under the Affordable Care Act (ACA)
* Partnership discussions are ongoing for the commercialization of PHEXX in international markets.

Read Our Latest Press Releases

[click here][43]

## A Paradigm Shift in Contraception

23M+ women in the U.S. are not using a hormonal contraceptive.²

As the organic movement grows, society is trending in favor of more natural products and solutions.
Women’s healthcare is no different. Many women are now opting for a non-hormonal, localized method
of birth control. 

Because PHEXX is a non-hormonal birth control, it is not associated with side effects like
depression, mood swings and irritability. With PHEXX, women do not need to choose between their
quality of life or contraception.

Taking hormones may not be right for some women especially for those with certain medical conditions
including clotting disorders and most cancers, limiting their birth control options. There are
approximately 800,000 new cases of cancer reported annually among women.³  PHEXX uniquely offers
hormone-free, non-invasive prescription contraception.

Phexxi^{®} is an on-demand method of birth control used to prevent pregnancy. Phexxi is not
effective when used after sex.

#### IMPORTANT safety information

Rare cases (0.36%) of bladder and kidney infection have been reported. If you have a history of
urinary tract problems that keep coming back, you should not use Phexxi^{®}.

Contact your healthcare provider if you are experiencing genitourinary side effects such as vaginal
burning, itching, discharge, genital discomfort (including in male partners), yeast infection,
urinary tract infection or bacterial vaginosis.

Phexxi does not protect against any sexually transmitted infections, including HIV. Avoid using

# Better health. Within reach. Every day.

As a global pharmaceutical company, at Hikma we are creating high-quality products and making them
accessible to those who need them, helping to shape a healthier world that enriches all our
communities.

[ Who we are ][82]
Play video
Transcript

**SR 2025 VIDEO**

I am pleased to announce the publication of our 2025 sustainability report. This report highlights
our Sustainability Approach and , and our commitment to Acting Responsibly. For 50 years we've
focused on producing high-quality medicines and contributing to a healthy society. Our aim is to put
better health within reach every day. 

Our approach to sustainability rests on four key pillars, at the center, our core pillar of
advancing health and wellbeing, and in support are our three pillars on empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically. 

In 2025, we created a clear  and coherent access to medicine strategy and introduced a set of
metrics through which we can measure and benchmark our performance. 

Globally, we were able to treat more than 222 million patients, which demonstrates the true impact
of our efforts. 2025 also saw continued work with our communities by providing educational
opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. Skip to content

opportunities, food donations and offering medicines to those most in need. And in total we donated
medicines worth more than $2.6m. Community engagement and social responsibility is something that is
ingrained in our culture, over the course of the year we reached more than 560,000 people through
our community outreach programmes. 

We also continued to support out people. Our recently completed People Voice Survey showed employee
engagement at 73% and employee enablement at 68%. The results will help guide our employee
programmes and help continue to make Hikma a great place to work. 

Throughout 2025, we continued to improve  our environmental performance, focusing specifically on
mitigating our emissions and establishing a more robust approach to water management, particularly
in the water scarce countries where we operate. As an example, we established water stewardship and
absolute CO2 emission reduction KPIs that link directly to Executive remuneration.

We also opened a new 1MW solar park in Jordan, and have plans to go much further in the coming
years.

Finally, we also spent 2025 continuing to focus on ethics and transparency across our value chain,
and taking serious measures to safeguard fundamental human rights both in the upstream and
downstream parts of our business. 

This year, for the first time we asked our key suppliers to rate us on how well we work with them,
and how we uphold our own Code of Conduct.

We believe that our high-quality medicines should reach everyone who needs them . This is why we
focus on acting responsibly, that means advancing health and wellbeing, empowering our people,
protecting the environment, and operating transparently and ethically.

# Patients are Our Passion


The right drugs, the right knowledge and the right people can transform everyday decisions into
everyday triumphs.

[Learn More][13]
**Our Products**
**NUZYRA®**  is an FDA-approved tetracycline-class antibiotic designed to address a significant
unmet need for adult patients with CABP and ABSSSI caused by susceptible bacteria.
[About NUZYRA®][14]

**XHANCE®** is a prescription nasal spray approved by the U.S. FDA for the treatment of chronic
rhinosinusitis with or without nasal polyps in adults.
[About XHANCE®][15]
**Groundbreaking Innovators**
A disciplined team with proven capabilities in developing and commercializing new treatment options
for complex medical issues.
‍

[Meet Our Team][16]
**Powered by You**
Our employees are experienced, committed, and driven to build a company that makes a positive
difference in patients' lives. Learn more about how you can join our team.
[View Open Roles][17]

## Taking on the Challenge of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)

"Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is a critical, global public health issue and an ongoing pandemic.
Efforts to combat AMR require a multi-pronged approach, including responsible antibiotic use,
improved surveillance, research into new antibiotics, and policy changes to enable a vibrant
marketplace that recognizes the life-saving value of novel antibiotics. Paratek is a
biopharmaceutical company that is dedicated to addressing AMR, a critical concern for public health
and national security."

#### Evan Loh, M.D. CEO, Paratek

[Taking on the Challenge of Antimicrobial Resistance (AMR)][18]

## Expanding Impact in Chronic Rhinosinusitis

Treatment of chronic rhinosinusitis (CRS) requires additional innovations, including in methods of
delivery to the site of inflammation. Paratek is committed to reaching both specialists and primary
care providers to address the unmet patient needs in CRS.


[Expanding Impact in Chronic Rhinosinusitis][19]

## Building a Stronger Future in Specialty Pharmaceuticals

Paratek provides innovative therapies for specialists and community care providers. Our portfolio of
products help address public health threats and important unmet medical needs.


[Building a Stronger Future in Specialty Pharmaceuticals][20]

# Developing Novel Medicines for Immune-Mediated Diseases

Spero Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing innovative medicines for
immune-mediated diseases, beginning with SP001, a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody in
development for IgG4-related disease.

### Building Value

### Purposeful Selection, Agile Execution

Spero prioritizes programs where compelling biology, clear patient need, and meaningful
differentiation from existing treatment options converge. Building on a proven track record of
clinical development and execution, including the successful development of Utebzi™¹, our team is
advancing therapies with the potential to meaningfully improve patients’ lives.

[About Us][17]

### SP001 in Rheumatology

### Where Biology, Patient Need, and Clinical Path Converge

SP001 is a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody, designed to inhibit a key immune signaling pathway
involved in driving inflammation and disease. By acting upstream in the immune cascade, SP001 has
the potential to reduce disease activity without broadly eliminating immune cells. Spero is
advancing SP001 in IgG4-related disease, a rare, systemic disease marked by chronic inflammation and
tissue fibrosis, and evaluating its potential in additional immune-mediated conditions.

[Programs][18]

#### ¹*Utebzi *(*Tebipenem pivoxil) was developed in collaboration with GSK. GSK entered into an
#### exclusive license agreement with Spero Therapeutics for the development and commercialization
#### in all markets, except certain Asian territories.*

# Developing Novel Medicines for Immune-Mediated Diseases

Spero Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company advancing innovative medicines for
immune-mediated diseases, beginning with SP001, a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody in
development for IgG4-related disease.

### Building Value

### Purposeful Selection, Agile Execution

Spero prioritizes programs where compelling biology, clear patient need, and meaningful
differentiation from existing treatment options converge. Building on a proven track record of
clinical development and execution, including the successful development of Utebzi™¹, our team is
advancing therapies with the potential to meaningfully improve patients’ lives.

[About Us][17]

### SP001 in Rheumatology

### Where Biology, Patient Need, and Clinical Path Converge

SP001 is a third-generation anti-CD40L antibody, designed to inhibit a key immune signaling pathway
involved in driving inflammation and disease. By acting upstream in the immune cascade, SP001 has
the potential to reduce disease activity without broadly eliminating immune cells. Spero is
advancing SP001 in IgG4-related disease, a rare, systemic disease marked by chronic inflammation and
tissue fibrosis, and evaluating its potential in additional immune-mediated conditions.

[Programs][18]

#### ¹*Utebzi *(*Tebipenem pivoxil) was developed in collaboration with GSK. GSK entered into an
#### exclusive license agreement with Spero Therapeutics for the development and commercialization
#### in all markets, except certain Asian territories.*

## **Pharmaceutical Manufacturers in India**

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

Energy Security Framework Gas Prices Explained Permitting Reform American Energy Snapshot

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

[Learn More][36]
[Download The Framework][37]
[AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK]

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

# **ESV Pharma**

**PHARMACUETICAL   PRODUCTS**

## Canadian Based Pharmaceutical Products

ESV Pharma is committed towards the healthcare of the citizens to the pharmacists and to the medical
community to meet the challenges of today’s rapidly changing pharmaceutical environment. Offering
best in class medicines, ESV Pharma is distributing its products across various markets through an
efficient supply chain.

### OUR VISION

We are a pharmaceutical company of future. Our Vision is to become a leading and dominant
pharmaceutical company in North America that complies with global market trends and standards and at
the same time sets its own leading standards.

### OUR MISSION

Our Mission is to provide our customers with the products of best quality and price and at the same
time to bring them Happiness, Health and Wellness. Our Business model delivers outstanding value to

###### Teams are shipping faster than ever

AI agents handle drafts, code generation, research, and documentation. But there's a disconnect
that's slowing everything down: the place where your team thinks, plans, and refines their work
isn't the same place your agents can access it.

###### What's missing is a shared layer

Your team and your agents should always be working from the same source of truth, a place where the
team sets direction, agents contribute, and everything stays aligned as ideas move from rough draft
to polished output ready to ship.

It's not just a collaboration tool for your team, but the shared context layer that keeps your team
and your agents in sync. Your team refines ideas in one place, agents pull from that same place, and
when agents contribute something back, it lands right where the team can review, edit, and build on
it together.

contributors or ten thousand.

docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.

* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace

Markdown content uses up to 80% fewer tokens than the equivalent HTML, so your agents spend their
compute on the actual work, reducing cost for your team.

Real-time editing with multiple cursors, comments, version history, and GitHub sync. Everything your
team already counts on, every day.
* [Live editing with multiple cursors][25]
* [Comments & mentions][26]
* [Version history][27]
* [Templates][28]
* [GitHub integration][29]
Every edit, every comment, every revision is tracked and recoverable, so your team's thinking isn't
just captured in the final draft but in the full history of how you got there. That means onboarding
someone new, revisiting a past decision, or understanding why something changed is never more than a
scroll through the version timeline.[
Explore features][30]
[Built for how communities actually work illustration]

#### Built for how communities actually work

From hackathons and research groups to open-source projects, study groups, and devnets, HackMD has
been the working surface for communities that build knowledge in the open.
* Public notes
* [Shared workspaces][31]
* [Embeds][32]
* [Slide mode][33]
* Open-source friendly
When your community has a home base where anyone can show up, share what they know, and start
building with each other, that's when things start to take off. HackMD gives your community a place
to gather around ideas, engage with each other's work, and grow together, whether that's ten
contributors or ten thousand.[
See community stories][34]
[Markdown your team writes illustration]

#### Give your agents the context they need, without the overhead

Every HackMD note is Markdown all the way down, which means your agents can pull context, reference
docs, and team knowledge through the same URLs your team uses.
* Pull any note as Markdown via REST API or CLI
* Push agent-generated drafts back into your workspace
* Agent gets Markdown via Accept: text/markdown

#### While expanding a current business or while venturing into new business, entrepreneurs are
#### often faced with the dilemma of zeroing in on a suitable product/line.

The report provides an expansive market analysis by covering areas like: growth drivers, trends
prevailing in the industry, Demand-Supply Situation, Foreign Trade, Porters 5 Forces Analysis,
regulatory framework as well as comprehensive SWOT analysis of the sector.

The report further establishes the regulatory framework of the industry. It encapsulates the status
of the current legislation in the industry as well as the recent changes and developments in the
regulations. The report also provides key player profiles along with key financials and comparison.
The market research report shares vital information like shareholding pattern, revenue mix, plant
location and financial summary of the key companies.

[Learn More ][82]

#### Industrial Development Technologies & Project Opportunities

Entrepreneur India,  a monthly magazine published by Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) is
aimed at simplifying the process of choosing the suitable project for investment. It makes business
decisions easier and trouble-free by providing a list of right projects for investment. Unique among
project investment magazines, 'Entrepreneur India' is dedicated to the business of identifying sound
investment projects. Every issue consists of a new list of projects which are meticulously selected
by the Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team after being screened on various investment
factors. Niir Project Consultancy Services (NPCS) team, before labeling a project as 'Right

to overcome hyper-cellular mutation of bacteria and viruses. Recce’s anti-infectives are unique –
their potency does not diminish even with repeated use, a common failure associated with existing
drugs.

to treat’ bacterial infections – including their mutated forms.

### About

**Zoom Earth** is an interactive weather map of the world.

Explore the current weather and detailed forecasts for your location with stunning, interactive maps
showing rain, wind, temperature, pressure, and more.

With **Zoom Earth** you can track the development of hurricanes and storms, monitor wildfires and
smoke, and stay aware of the latest conditions by viewing satellite imagery and rain radar updated
in near real time.

#### Mobile App

[[App]][1] [[QR]][2]

Download the [**Zoom Earth**][3] app!

**Scan the QR code** with the camera on your mobile device to get the **Zoom Earth** app.

Available on the [App Store][4] for iPhone and iPad, and on [Google Play][5] for Android.

#### Data Sources

Weather forecasts are continually updated with the latest global model data from DWD [ICON][6] and
NOAA/NCEP/NWS [GFS][7].

Radar data is processed in real time from many meteorological [sources][8] around the world.

Live satellite imagery is provided by [NOAA GOES][9], [EUMETSAT Meteosat][10], and [JMA
Himawari][11] geostationary satellites.

HD satellite images are updated twice a day from NASA polar-orbiting satellites [Aqua][12] and
[Terra][13], using services from [GIBS][14], part of [EOSDIS][15].

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from [NHC][16], [JTWC][17], [NRL][18],
and [IBTrACS][19].

Active fire data is compiled from many sources, including [NIFC][20], [CIFFC][21], Australian fire
agencies, [Copernicus EMS][22], and [GDACS][23].

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are
updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE [FIRMS][24].

Map labels © [OpenStreetMap][25] contributors.

#### Contact

Please use our [contact form][26] to send us your comments, questions, or suggestions.

© 2026 Neave Interactive Ltd.

[Terms of Service][27]

[Privacy Policy][28]

### Heat Spots

Heat spots are **not live!** Detections are updated *daily* and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the *approximate* locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These
spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as *hot smoke* or *agriculture*.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

**Do not** use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always
refer to local authorities for the latest information.

[Terra][13], using services from [GIBS][14], part of [EOSDIS][15].

Tropical system tracks are generated using the latest data from [NHC][16], [JTWC][17], [NRL][18],
and [IBTrACS][19].

Active fire data is compiled from many sources, including [NIFC][20], [CIFFC][21], Australian fire
agencies, [Copernicus EMS][22], and [GDACS][23].

The heat spots overlay shows points of very high temperature detected by satellite. Detections are
updated daily, not live, with data from NASA LANCE [FIRMS][24].

### Heat Spots

Heat spots are **not live!** Detections are updated *daily* and are delayed by many hours.

Red spots show the *approximate* locations of very high temperature detected by satellite. These
spots may be from fire or other sources of heat such as *hot smoke* or *agriculture*.

Clouds may prevent the detection of heat.

**Do not** use for the preservation of life or property! Detections have limited accuracy. Always
refer to local authorities for the latest information.
